name: Dal Bloodclaw's Skull
summary: In northern Ashenvale, Dal Bloodclaw's Skull marks the end of a threat to Astranaar. Raene Wolfrunner receives it as proof that an attack on the night elf settlement has been averted.

sections.title: A Chieftain's Downfall
sections.body: The Thistlefur furbolgs north of Astranaar have grown in number and aggression. Like much of Ashenvale's ancient forest, they have been corrupted. Raene Wolfrunner, a night elf sentinel, fears they will soon march on Astranaar. She orders their ranks culled and their leader, Dal Bloodclaw, slain. His skull gives grim proof that the tribe's leadership has been shattered, buying Astranaar's defenders precious time.

faq.answer: Dal Bloodclaw led the Thistlefur furbolgs at Thistlefur Hold, just north of Astranaar. The hostile tribe grew rapidly under his leadership and threatened the nearby night elf outpost.

faq.q: Why does Raene Wolfrunner want the skull?
faq.answer: Raene Wolfrunner wants proof that the Thistlefur chieftain is dead. The night elves hope the surviving furbolgs will fall into disarray and lose any organized plans to attack Astranaar.

faq.q: Why are the Thistlefur furbolgs so hostile?
faq.answer: Like many furbolg tribes in Ashenvale, the Thistlefurs have succumbed to corruption spreading through the forest. They have become violent and territorial, threatening those who once lived beside them.

angles.text: As a night elf, you may see the sorrow in defeating fallen furbolg leaders. Corruption has twisted ancient allies, and they now threaten settlements such as Astranaar.
As an Alliance member, you help secure Astranaar's northern flank. The settlement is the Alliance's main sanctuary in central Ashenvale.
